ValidationRule.description: Ensures FATCA compliance before a Case is sent to Checker. When cc_Maker__c is changed to "Send to Checker", the rule validates that the related Account has a valid 11-digit Tax Country ID and FATCA Declaration Form Type
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(cc_Maker__c , "Send to Checker"), ISCHANGED(cc_Maker__c), ISPICKVAL(Region_Flag__c , "Jordan"), RecordType.DeveloperName = "On_Boarding", ISPICKVAL(Type , "FATCA"), OR( NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(Account.FATCA_Declaration_Form_Type__pc , "W-9"), ISPICKVAL(Account.FATCA_Declaration_Form_Type__pc , "W-8 BEN") ) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(Account.FATCA_Declaration_Form_Type__pc , "W-9"), ISBLANK(Account.Tax_Country_1_ID__pc) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill the necessary details under the FATCA Details section to proceed.
